Detailed Description

This file contains all of the prototypes for all sparse linear algebra functions implemented in the files prefixed with slinalg_.

int _smatrix_insert ( smatrix_t *  mat_in,
long int  i_in,
long int  j_in,
long int  idx_in,
double  val_in 
)

Used internally only; Does not modify nvals.

This function takes the actual index into the row. This is emphasized by using idx_in instead of j_in, which would be a column index rather than an insertion point. User must call binary_search() to get the desired insertion index before calling _smatrix_insert().

void smatrix_dsplud ( smatrix_t *  mat_in  ) 

Sparse LU decomposition for linear solution.

This is a sparse LU decomposition algorithm.

Parameters:
mat_in The input matrix to decompose into lower and upper triangular components
mat_out The lower and upper triangular decomposition products are both stored in mat_out with the exception of the diagonal of the upper triangular component, which is all implicitly ones
